label: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) Scores
definition: A scale used to assess the consciousness level of patients, particularly after head injury.

label: Patient Outcome
definition: The result of medical treatment or the progression of a disease.

label: Patient Data
definition: Information collected from patients during their treatment, which can include various physiological parameters and clinical observations.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Data collected regarding the outcomes of treatment and management approaches in patients with brain injury.

label: Brain Injury
definition: A condition resulting from damage to the brain, which can be monitored and treated in intensive care settings.

label: Sensor Accuracy
definition: The degree to which a sensor's readings reflect the true value of the parameter being measured.

label: Electrocardiogram (ECG)
definition: A test that records the electrical activity of the heart.

label: Treatment Data
definition: Data related to the treatments administered to patients, particularly in the context of brain injury management.

label: Medical Disorders
definition: A category encompassing various health conditions that can affect physiological parameters.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: A non-invasive ultrasound technique used to measure blood flow velocity in the brain's major arteries.

label: Neurointensive Care Data
definition: High-resolution data collected specifically for the care of patients with severe neurological conditions.

label: Error
definition: A classification indicating a potential issue with recorded medical data.

label: Computed Tomography (ct)-scan Data
definition: Information obtained from CT scans used to assess brain injuries.

label: Head Injury
definition: A condition characterized by damage to the head, which can lead to serious health consequences including death and long-term morbidity.

label: Machine
definition: A device used in medical evaluations that may contain various sensors.

label: Assessment
definition: An evaluation of medical data using predefined rules and queries.

label: Platform
definition: An intermediate category introduced by Chain-of-Layer taxonomy construction.

label: Admission Data
definition: Data collected at the time of patient admission to the intensive care unit, relevant for brain injury cases.

label: End-tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: The concentration of carbon dioxide at the end of an exhaled breath, used to monitor ventilation.

label: Reading
definition: A recorded observation of a specific parameter and its value.

label: Property
definition: A characteristic or attribute of a medical measurement or observation.

label: Provenance
definition: Information describing the entities and processes involved in producing medical observations.
